prs.title: fix(server): replay request SSE responses after closeSSEStream
prs.author: fallintoplace
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: SSE event replay is broken after a stream is closed. PR #1681 patches the server transport: it introduces a typed ERR_MCP_REPLAY_STREAM_CLOSED sentinel and a closeStreamController guard so the replay loop does not throw unhandled when it enqueues into an already-closed ReadableStreamDefaultController.
